title: Witness and Letter
author: Cyrus Almeida
blurb: Casper Joubert, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
